_readme: Source for academy section and course pages. Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/build_academy_courses.py. Each course gets /<section>/<course>/ plus short links /<section>/<course>/{notes,slides,tutorial}. Leave notes or slides empty if there is none.

courses.title: Statistics Fundamentals
courses.summary: The statistics every data scientist needs: describing data, probability, distributions, inference, regression, experiments and the pitfalls that lead to wrong conclusions.
prerequisites: Basic Python (variables, lists, functions) for the exercises
courses.audience: Aspiring data scientists, analysts, and engineers moving into machine learning.
modules: Turning data into decisions while being honest about uncertainty, and the mistakes that cost the most.
Center, spread, shape and relationships, and why you always plot before you summarize.
Random variables, conditional probability, Bayes' theorem, expectation and the Central Limit Theorem.
Normal, binomial, Poisson, exponential, t, chi-square, F and heavy-tailed distributions, and when each applies.
Sampling, confidence intervals, p-values, error types and power, common tests, multiple comparisons and the bootstrap.
Linear and logistic regression, GLMs, time series basics and the bias-variance trade-off.
A/B testing done right, and causal methods for when you can't run an experiment.
Practical vs statistical significance, leakage and bias, outliers, small samples and pre-registration.

courses.title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
courses.summary: How machine learning works end to end: the workflow, data preparation, core algorithms, evaluation, tuning and responsible use.
courses.audience: Analysts and engineers building their first predictive models.

courses.title: MLOps
courses.summary: Running machine learning in production: the ML lifecycle, maturity levels, data and model management, deployment, monitoring and maintenance.
courses.tools: Experiment tracking, model registries, CI/CD, cloud ML platforms
courses.audience: Data scientists and ML engineers taking models from notebooks to production.

courses.title: AutoML
courses.summary: What automated machine learning does, how it works under the hood, when to use it, its limits, and where the data scientist still matters.
courses.audience: Data scientists and analysts who want faster baselines without losing control.
modules: How it works under the hood
The data scientist's role with AutoML

courses.title: Deep Learning Fundamentals
courses.summary: How neural networks learn: building blocks, training and regularization, convolutional and sequence models, transformers and transfer learning, and the tools to use them well.
courses.audience: Data scientists and ML engineers moving from classical models to neural networks.

courses.title: Generative AI Fundamentals
courses.summary: What generative AI is, the main model families, how large language models work, adapting them to your use case, evaluation and responsible use.
courses.audience: Data scientists, engineers and technical leads starting with generative AI.
modules: Adapting models to your use case

courses.title: LLMOps
courses.summary: Building and running LLM applications in production: the lifecycle, prompt management, RAG, fine-tuning, evaluation, monitoring, cost and safety.
courses.tools: Prompt management, vector databases, evaluation and monitoring tools
courses.audience: Engineers and data scientists shipping LLM features.

courses.title: Agentic AI Fundamentals
courses.summary: How AI agents plan, use tools and act: building blocks, design patterns, multi-agent systems, frameworks and protocols, evaluation and safe deployment.
courses.tools: Python, agent frameworks, tool calling and agent protocols
courses.audience: Engineers and architects designing agentic systems for the enterprise.

courses.title: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
courses.summary: What the cloud is and how it is priced, the service models, core compute, storage and networking, data and AI services, security, and cost management.

courses.title: AB-100: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect

courses.title: H3 Geospatial Indexing

modules: Why hexagons: H3 vs other grids
